name: Vyrelord/Vyrelady
requirements:
The Branches of Darkmeyer 
Blisterwood stakes, stake-thrower or the Sunspear
recommendations: Sunspear (ranged), obtained during the River of Blood quest, is the best weapon that can be used against vyres. Void Knight armour with the ranger helm is recommended unless on a slayer task, in which case a Full slayer helm or Focus sight would be more recommended. High magic protection equipment such as black or royal dragonhide or Armadyl armour to reduce the need of food. Protect from Magic, Deflect Magic or Soul Split are also very helpful.
advantages:
* Training here yields a high experience rate for little to no cost
* A good amount of money can be earned from drops such as blood runes, death runes, and splitbark Armour
* Close to Darkmeyer altar and bank chest, both behind closable doors
* Players who have completed The Lord of Vampyrium and River of Blood quests can respectively utilise the Blisterwood stake-thrower crossbow or Sunspear (ranged) in place of blisterwood stakes
disadvantages:
* Players must fletch their own Blisterwood weaponry (stakes or crossbow), as they are untradable
* Experience rates can be reduced substantially if even one more person is training in Darkmeyer; as Vyres are aggressive, making auto-retaliate less useful for training
* Unless a player has cremated a large number of vyre corpses, they will not achieve the high hits necessary to earn the best experience rates

name: Waterfiend
recommendations: A Charming imp is highly recommended here, as waterfiends frequently drop crimson charms.
advantages:
* Very good drops, such as noted water orbs and uncut sapphires, and high crimson charm drop rates
* Waterfiends' combat levels also allow for very high hard clue drop rates
* Once the Waterfiends become non-aggressive, they are quite easy to 3-hit with hand cannons for high kill/ammo rates. Players will need very little food once this occurs because of the Waterfiends' tendency to hit 1 on players more often than they either hit or miss
* Weak to bolts
* If player has access to fairy rings, they are very close to a bank at the Ancient Cavern
disadvantages:
* Ghorrock is very far from a bank; this is somewhat offset by the fact that most of their drops are noted
* Ghorrock is also very difficult to reach, see Ghorrock to find the best ways
* They are very popular for training, and are often crowded

name: Kree'arra and guards
requirements: Defeated Dad in Troll Stronghold, 70 Ranged
recommendations: A high Ranged level and high-level equipment. Create an instance with spawn setting on fast.
advantages:
* Excellent drops, such as noted dwarf weed and dwarf weed seeds, which fetch a high price on the GE, along with Armadyl armour and the Armadyl hilt
* Can be camped for hours without needing to bank if using a sufficient setup
disadvantages:
* Very far from a bank, and requires killcount to enter, which can hamper experience rates
* Sacrifices high XP for drops due to the boss' respawn time and limited opportunity to AoE
* Can be crowded if you choose not to create an instance
* You can die very easily if you are not paying attention
